violations.why: irq_vine can preempt main between the two reads of v_larch in fn_delta and change the value.
irq_nectar (after irq_flint sets v_walnut to 0) can write v_loom between main's two reads.
Higher-priority irq_vine can preempt irq_lantern after it writes 42 and overwrite v_velvet (it also writes it in fn_tide), so the check at line 159 can read a different value.
irq_vine can preempt irq_lantern between its write of v_knoll and the read in fn_wharf. The write is the same value, so the preemption is weakly harmful, but it fits the write-write-read shape.
